## Recommendation

- Recommended option: O-003
- Rationale: O-003 meets 11 of 12 criteria, including every must-have EC-001 to EC-005, and is the only platform option that meets EC-006 without the follower barrier of O-002 or the EC-001 failure of O-001; it is paired with form O-007 (11 of 12, footage-first so EC-001 and EC-008 hold under the adverse influencer branch) and niche O-008 (12 of 12), with O-009 as second niche; no score rests solely on a C8 unquoted rule or a third-party rate.
- Preconditions: RK-001 to RK-007 resolved or ruled by their owners; the CEO rules on the budget proposal (RK-014); disclosure and announcement in every video; samples bought outside affiliate links; no seller media; no synthetic narration.
- Options rejected: O-001 fails EC-001 under the broad clause reading (RK-001), held for later only on a written narrow reading; O-002 is the named single-platform fallback, not the lead, because EC-006 fails (RK-011); O-004 is the outcome only if blockers resolve adversely; O-005 is the starting mode of O-007, not a separate choice; O-006 fails EC-001, EC-004, EC-006 and EC-008; O-010 fails EC-001 and EC-009; O-011 fails EC-001, EC-006 and EC-009.
- Counsel branches (C1): competitor clause narrow keeps O-003 and allows O-001 later, broad keeps O-003 alone; influencer duty applies means sample and use for each product (already in O-007), does not apply leaves O-007 unchanged because disclosure stays; tax at 0, 2 or 5% or highest rate changes net only, see break-even; if Shopee Video is not a permitted channel the fallback is O-002.
- Standing decisions (proposed for the CEO's ruling): D-005 amend, affiliate becomes the lead revenue line for the pilot while disclosure stays a publishing check; D-007 amend, add Shopee Video Vietnam (TikTok Shop as fallback) with the Vietnam-resident payee unchanged, since the Creator Rewards exclusion does not touch affiliate; D-008 amend, add one Vietnamese pilot channel while the English YouTube channel stays first for YouTube and frozen, not cancelled; D-021 amend, part 2 (always disclose by platform control and in-video) kept, part 1 (Vietnamese gaps carried) superseded for the pilot because Vietnamese content puts the gap on the critical path, routed to counsel; D-022 keep for the frozen YouTube first item and not applied to the pilot, where every item carries a disclosed link.
- Coverage of "every": every counsel branch means competitor clause narrow or broad, influencer duty applies or not, PIT 0, 2, 5% or highest rate, channel permitted or not; every publication means each Shopee Video post, its caption and product link, any fallback TikTok post, and any re-post; livestream is out of pilot scope.

## Delivery Impact

- Effort and capacity: O-003 with O-007 is medium effort, almost all of it CEO time (account, samples, filming, approval); agent effort is small (scripts, captions, overlay facts with provenance); overlays add architect effort of unknown size (RK-016).
- Break-even formula: monthly net commission = sum over orders of (order net value × commission rate × (1 − void rate)) × net factor; Shopee net factor = 0.9902 for payouts below VND 250,000 and (1 − 0.0098) × (1 − 0.10) = 0.89118 at or above it (E-098, E-100; fee base assumed gross); TikTok net factor = 0.99 × (1 − t) for t of 0, 0.02, 0.05 or the highest rate, less USD 0.12 per withdrawal (E-014, E-015 2024 page); break-even orders = pilot incremental cost ÷ (AOV × rate × net factor).
- Break-even ESTIMATE: assumptions are 6 samples at AOV USD 7 (E-115 third-party, low) giving a pilot cost of USD 42, metered spend USD 0 (no generative model), void rate 0, Shopee factor 0.89118, and hypothetical rates not sourced; at 3.68% (E-093 third-party) 7 × 0.0368 × 0.89118 = USD 0.2296 per order, 42 ÷ 0.2296 = 183 orders; at 10% USD 0.6238 per order, 68 orders; at 20% USD 1.2477 per order, 34 orders.
- Budget proposal for owner approval: fund samples of up to USD 42 per month from the USD 42.99 standing line if uncommitted, or raise the monthly budget by that amount; the USD 34.42 metered ceiling is unchanged and unused by the pilot.
- Proposed 30-day target (CEO chooses one): tier 1, the measurement set recorded for every published video; tier 2, at least one valid commission paid out (proposed); tier 3, net commission at or above the pilot incremental cost (34 to 183 orders by the ESTIMATE).
- Measurements: views, link clicks, click-through rate, orders, conversion rate, AOV, void and return rate, commission rate per product from the dashboard, payout and withholding observed, CEO minutes per video, cost per video, warnings or takedowns.
- CEO personal actions: confirm age, chip CCCD with NFC and tax code; obtain counsel answers; ask Shopee in writing about the competitor clause and Shopee Video; create the KOC account and add bank details himself; read and record the rate table; choose products and buy samples with his own money outside affiliate links; use each product; film hands-only footage in Vietnamese; approve every publication with disclosure; record the measurements.
- Sequencing constraints: preconditions (RK-004 to RK-007) and counsel answers (RK-001 to RK-003) first; then the CEO's budget and standing-decision rulings; then account, samples and footage-only publication; overlays only after RK-016.
- Dependencies: counsel; Shopee support; context-agent page re-capture; architect for pipeline adaptation; planner for any task breakdown; commands run (read-only): git log --oneline -1 main (4acbd2a), git ls-tree -r --name-only main src graphics (161 files), python runtime/technical_recommendation_validator.py on this artifact.
- Reversal plan: stop publishing, withdraw the balance above VND 10,000 (E-087 unquoted), keep samples; fall back to O-002 or O-004; re-capture E-110 first so the exit cost is known.

## Recommendation

- Recommended option: O-003
- Rationale: O-003 now meets all 12 criteria, every must-have EC-001 to EC-005 included, and is the only platform option meeting EC-006 without the follower barrier of O-002 (EC-006 missed) or the EC-001 failure of O-001; the quoted E-110 shows that stopping without breach carries no stated cost, so EC-010 moves from missed to met; it is paired with form O-007 started footage-only (11 of 12, EC-001 and EC-008 hold under the adverse influencer branch) and niche O-008 (12 of 12), with O-009 second and O-002 as the single-platform fallback.
- Preconditions: CEO eligibility confirmed (RK-004); owner rulings on D-005, D-007, D-008, D-021, D-022 (RK-006), the sample line (RK-014), the sign-up form and the 30-day tier; the mitigations of RK-001, RK-002, RK-007, RK-009, RK-010 and RK-015 held as publishing rules; counsel engaged on Q-001 to Q-006.
- Options rejected: O-001 fails EC-001, EC-007, EC-008 and EC-010 because E-104 sets no reach (RK-001); O-002 fails EC-006, EC-007 and EC-008 and is the named fallback; O-004 fails EC-006, EC-011 and EC-012 and is the outcome only if conditions resolve adversely; O-005 fails EC-007 and EC-012 and is the starting mode of O-007; O-006 fails EC-001, EC-004, EC-006 and EC-008; O-010 fails EC-001, EC-009 and EC-011; O-011 fails EC-001, EC-006, EC-009 and EC-011.
- Path, order and fallback: 1) Shopee Affiliate KOC on Shopee Video, home and kitchen (O-003, O-007 footage-only, O-008); 2) after day 30, add O-009 or overlays only on measured results and RK-016; 3) fallback O-002 if RK-007 fails, started only after Shopee activity ends or a written E-104 reading permits both; 4) O-004 if eligibility or the owner rulings fail.
- First 30-day plan: before day 1 the preconditions above; days 1 to 3 the CEO signs up as an individual KOC, enters payment data, reads rates and checks Shopee Video attribution; days 4 to 7 he picks up to 6 low-claim products not on the no-commission list (E-103), buys and uses the samples; days 8 to 28 he publishes up to 2 footage-first Vietnamese videos per product, each published only after his own review, with in-video and caption disclosure; days 29 to 30 the results are read against the chosen tier.
- Measurements: per video views, product clicks, click-through rate, orders, conversion rate, AOV, commission per order, voids and returns, CEO minutes, sample cost, labels, warnings or takedowns; per period the rate per product from the dashboard, payouts, the amount withheld (the observed PIT rate), dispute notices within the 24-hour window (E-102) and booking emails.
- CEO personal actions, in order: 1) confirm age, chip CCCD, tax code and own bank account privately; 2) take the owner decisions below; 3) send counsel the open points; 4) create the Shopee Affiliate account himself, read and accept the terms, register no TikTok channel, enter payment data; 5) read and record rates and confirm Shopee Video attribution; 6) choose products and buy samples with his own money outside affiliate links; 7) use each product; 8) film hands-only footage with his own Vietnamese voice; 9) approve and publish each video himself with disclosure; 10) check email at least every 2 days and commission results daily; 11) record the measurements and rule on day 30.
- Open points for local counsel: competitor clause reach and a later TikTok account (Q-001); Art. 15a(3) scope for an affiliate (Q-002); PIT classification, rate, withholder and sign-up form now that E-100 is gone (Q-003); AI-label reach to code-drawn overlays under Law 134/2025 (Q-005); seller media reuse (Q-006); Vietnamese disclosure form and penalties under the amended advertising law, tied to D-021 part 1 (Q-012).
- Owner decisions: OD1 D-005 amend, affiliate the lead revenue line for the pilot; OD2 D-007 amend, add Shopee Affiliate VN with the CEO as Vietnam-resident individual payee, TikTok Shop fallback only; OD3 D-008 amend, add one Vietnamese Shopee Video pilot channel, English YouTube first and frozen; OD4 D-021 amend, keep part 2 (always disclose), supersede part 1 for the pilot and route to counsel; OD5 D-022 keep for the frozen YouTube first item, not applied to the pilot; OD6 sample line up to USD 42 per month; OD7 30-day target tier; OD8 sign up as individual (default, convertible per E-081) pending counsel; OD9 start before counsel answers Q-001 and Q-002, since the plan complies under both; OD10 decline Shopee bookings during the pilot; OD11 path O-003 with O-007 footage-first, niche O-008 then O-009, O-010 and O-011 excluded.
- Coverage of "every": every counsel branch means E-104 narrow or broad; Art. 15a(3) applies or not; PIT for a non-business individual at 0, 2, 5 or 10%, or 5% VAT plus 5% PIT as a business individual; Shopee Video attributes or not; every publication means each Shopee Video post, its caption and product tag, any fallback TikTok post, and any re-post; livestream is outside the pilot.

## Delivery Impact

- Effort and capacity: O-003 with O-007 footage-first is medium effort, almost all of it CEO time (sign-up, samples, use, filming, approval, measurement), with CEO minutes per video unknown until measured; agent effort is small (scripts, captions, disclosure text, measurement sheet); overlays add architect effort of unknown size (RK-016) and are outside the 30 days.
- Tax range (replaces the E-100 figure): Shopee net factor = (1 − 0.0098 − t) at worst and 0.9902 × (1 − t) at best, for t of 0, 2, 5 or 10% (E-060, E-061, E-070, E-071 guidance or low), or t = 10% as a business individual (5% VAT plus 5% PIT, E-101 confirmed); range 0.8902 to 0.9902; the 0.98% fee rests on E-098, not re-captured; TikTok's highest-rate case does not arise on Shopee because a tax code is mandatory (E-085).
- Break-even ESTIMATE: 6 samples at AOV USD 7 (E-115 third-party, low) give a pilot cost of USD 42; metered spend USD 0; void rate 0; at 3.68% (E-093 third-party) 165 to 184 orders, at 10% 61 to 68, at 20% 31 to 34, across net factors 0.9902 to 0.8902; rates are hypothetical, not sourced; arithmetic run with python -c, recorded under Dependencies.
- Budget proposal for owner approval: fund samples of up to USD 42 per month from the USD 42.99 standing line if uncommitted, or raise the monthly budget by that amount; the USD 34.42 metered ceiling is unchanged and unused.
- 30-day target (CEO chooses one): tier 1, the full measurement set for every published video; tier 2 (recommended), tier 1 plus at least one valid commission credited by day 30, because orders complete within 30 days of the visit (E-094) and the payout schedule is not re-captured (E-088); tier 3, net commission at or above the pilot cost (31 to 184 orders by the ESTIMATE).
- Sequencing constraints: eligibility and owner rulings first; sign-up and the attribution check before any sample is bought; samples used before filming; each publication cleared by the CEO individually; no TikTok Shop account while the Shopee account is active unless a written E-104 reading permits it; overlays only after RK-016 and Q-005.
- Dependencies: CEO; local counsel; Shopee support; context-agent for any further page re-capture; architect for pipeline adaptation; planner for any task breakdown; commands run (read-only): cat and sed of the run inputs, modules, gate record, re-capture and research/framework-defects.md; python -c arithmetic for the net factors and break-even; python runtime/technical_recommendation_validator.py on this artifact with the envelope.
- Reversal plan: stop publishing; stopping without breach carries no stated cost, and Shopee may end an account with no results for 6 months (E-110); keep payment data complete so earned balances above VND 10,000 are paid (E-087); keep the samples; accept no booking, since booked posts cannot be removed without Shopee's written request (E-089); then fall back to O-002 or O-004.

carry forward prior-release content the delivered change made false
resolve an engineering gap rather than returning it to the role that owns it
decide a gate that assesses evidence this agent produced
modify committed run evidence or a governance record
access external systems directly

repositoryWrites.scope: none. This agent writes its own artifact and its result envelope, and nothing else. Product documentation living in the repository is proposed as content inside the artifact and applied by the role that owns the file, so a documentation change never travels as an unreviewed write.
repositoryWrites.rationale: This agent's authority is over what is said about a change, never over the change itself. Writing to the repository would let a publication step alter the delivered behavior it exists to describe, and the resulting document would then be accurate about a system this agent had just modified.

commandExecution.purpose: none. Every fact this agent publishes comes from a supplied artifact, and a fact obtained by running a command would be this agent producing evidence rather than communicating it.
prohibitedPurposes: any command that modifies production source or committed run evidence
repository history rewriting, publishing, or release actions
reproducing a test or validation result, which belongs to qa

determinism.contract: Identical inputs and an identical context snapshot must produce the same published statements, the same known-issue set, the same compatibility statement, the same declared release verdict, and the same declared artifact status.
determinism.orderingRule: Known issues keep the order of the source that recorded them, so a supplied defect list and the issues published from it can be read side by side.
determinism.modelIndependence: No module may reference a specific model, vendor, or agent runtime. Technology names are permitted only when they trace to the supplied evidence, release context, or repository context.

model_tier.basis: declared light for research/findings-publication in config/model-tier-policy.json
